persons.name: Jayānanda
persons.evidence: ānanda paścat prathamo jayākhyo(exp. 28t1) cityārccaṇākhyaṃ vyalikhat

date.as_written: samvat 875 māgha śukla śrīpaṃcamī kavivāre / vāṇādrināgeṣu ca hāyanesmin, māgherjjune nāga(4)tithaubhi kāvye

notes: The date is given both in prose (saṃvat 875 māgha śukla śrīpañcamī kavivāre) and in chronogram verse (vāṇādrināgeṣu = 875, though the tithi in verse is read as nāgatithau).
